text: Calibrate Prisms to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms.

Calibration generates 3 random optional affixes, 1 of which is selected as the final result. Each Prism slot can be calibrated to produce a corresponding type of affix. Slot 1 can be calibrated with a Prism Effect Area affix. Slot 2 can be calibrated with a Prism Additional Effect Affix. Slot 3 can be calibrated with a Prism Legendary Mechanic Affix.
During calibration, a special additional material called Prism Level can be added. Its function is to make it possible to manually refresh the random affix options once.
Prisms that already have 1 or more random affixes can be restored using the restoration feature by spending certain materials. Prisms that have reached the Plasticity upper limit cannot be restored.
